name: rdc
description: See and control other computers that run RDC: connect by link or code, then work from screenshots with the mouse and keyboard.

interface.shortDescription: Let the agent see and control another computer that runs RDC.
interface.longDescription: RDC is a lightweight open-source remote desktop. Run it on the computer to control; it shows a link and a 9-digit code. Give the link to the agent: it connects, takes screenshots and uses the mouse and keyboard there. The person at that computer sees that an AI agent is connected and can stop it at any time.
capabilities: See the screen of another computer
Click, type and press keys there
Up to four computers at once
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect to my other computer with this RDC link and tell me what is on the screen:
